mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_policy (policy_no, user_id, parcel_id, premium, coverage, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{userId}, #{parcelId}, #{premium}, #{coverage}, #{status}, #{expireAt})
mapper.sql: i.*, p.tracking_no, p.status AS parcel_status, p.courier_company
mapper.select: SELECT FROM insurance_policy i JOIN parcel p ON p.id = i.parcel_id WHERE i.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.expire_at < now() AND p.status IN ('IN_STOCK','OVERDUE')
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance_policy SET status = 'CLAIM_PAID', claimed_at = now(), settled_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE insurance_policy SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at < now()
UPDATE insurance_policy SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE parcel_id = #{parcelId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
